title: Flat morphism of schemes
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For $x\in X$, $f$ induces a local homomorphism of local rings $\mathcal O_{S,f(x)}\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$. The morphism $f$ is *flat at $x$* if $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is a flat $\mathcal O_{S,f(x)}$-module, and *flat* if it is flat at every point of $X$.
